title: Toast notification queue
description: Short, non-blocking status messages that confirm actions or report background events: queued so they never stack into a wall, with a consistent position, optional single action (such as Undo), pause on hover or focus, and timeouts long enough to read. Critical errors do not use toasts.
intent: Confirm what just happened without interrupting the task, and offer a quick undo where it helps.
characteristics: one visible at a time (or max three) with a queue
timeout scales with message length; no timeout when there is an action
consistent placement that avoids primary controls
interaction: Appears with a short enter transition; actions are reachable by keyboard without stealing focus; a keyboard shortcut or landmark lets users reach the toast region; dismiss button on every toast.
responsive: Bottom, full width minus gutters on narrow screens, above any bottom navigation; corner position on wide screens.
accessibility: Region with role="status" (polite) for confirmations; never put critical errors or required decisions in a toast; respect reduced motion; provide a way to review recent notifications if messages matter.
limitations: Easy to miss for screen magnifier users; important information also needs a persistent place.
Undo requires the action to be reversible on the backend for the toast duration.
